name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Nexus
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a 36-bit Nexus temperature and humidity sensor code, as used by Digoo and similar 433 MHz weather sensors, to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The 8-bit address (sensor ID) to send, 0 to 255. Each sensor has its own.

config_entries.label: Humidity
config_entries.description: The humidity to send in %. The field is 8 bits wide, so values up to 255 are accepted.

config_entries.label: Temperature
config_entries.description: The temperature to send in °C, with a resolution of 0.1 °C, between -204.8 and 204.7.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Battery Level
config_entries.description: The battery flag to send, `true` for a normal battery and `false` for a low one. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Force Update
config_entries.description: The forced transmission flag, `true` when the sensor sends because its button was pressed. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
